videoTemplates.subtitle: Find a scene. Make it yours.
videoTemplates.description: Rap at a studio mic, dance with friends or give your pet the starring role. Preview a template, add your photos and check the credit price before creating.
videoTemplates.availabilityNote: Hover to preview with sound off. These are reference examples; check generation availability inside each template.

descriptions.bulin-47: One photo. A red-lit street freestyle with a crowd.

descriptions.58th-floor: A teal studio, a hanging mic and your solo or duet.
descriptions.green-booth-freestyle: Two portraits, one shared mic and a green studio freestyle.

guide.settingsText: The scene is included. Choose your settings to see the full credit price instantly, then click Create.
guide.resultText: Submit once, then follow the video in your account history. Watch the finished result before downloading or sharing.
guide.costA: Watching examples does not use credits. Sign in to see the price for your settings. Video uses account credits; image passes do not cover it.
guide.sampleQ: Will my video look exactly like the example?
guide.sampleA: The example demonstrates the scene and movement. Your photos guide the subjects, and AI can change details, timing and sound. Review your result before sharing.
guide.uploadQ: Can I upload a large photo?
guide.uploadA: Yes. Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP up to 40 MB. Photos above the template’s upload limit are resized and compressed in your browser before uploading; smaller photos stay unchanged. If optimization fails, choose a smaller file.

original-rap.title: AI Rap Video Generator
original-rap.lead: Bring your photos to the mic. Choose Orange Studio, Street Cypher, Neon Rap or Funny Rap, then add your own lyrics or keep the prepared performance.
original-rap.about: Create a solo or duo rap performance using your portraits, or start without a photo. The selected stage sets the atmosphere; lyrics, an occasion and optional scene details let you shape the concept.
original-rap.photoHint: Use one clear portrait for each performer, with the face and outfit visible. No-photo mode needs no uploads.
original-rap.sound: The model creates the performance audio. Lyrics and timing can vary; this is not a voice-cloning control.
original-rap.faqQ: Do I need to write a prompt?
original-rap.faqA: No. You can keep a prepared performance. Add your own lyrics or direction when you want a different concept.

bulin-47.title: Bulin 47 AI
bulin-47.lead: Make your photo the lead in a street freestyle: a red-lit doorway, a staircase, a nearby crowd and confident close-up gestures.
bulin-47.about: Bulin 47 AI uses one photo for a 15-second vertical performance. The preset supplies the scene, gestures and audio cues, while your photo guides the lead’s appearance and clothing.
bulin-47.photoHint: Choose one clear photo of yourself, a consenting adult friend or a pet. Keep the face and visible outfit unobstructed.
bulin-47.sound: Sound is model-generated using the preset audio cues. It is not a promise of the original recording or an identical voice.
bulin-47.faqQ: Do I need a second photo or a background?
bulin-47.faqA: No. This is a one-photo freestyle. The scene and supporting cast are already part of the template.

spin-me-round.title: Spin Me Round Dance AI
spin-me-round.lead: Turn one, two or three portraits into a playful dance: broad arm circles, springy steps and a full turn in an empty room or retro neon disco.
spin-me-round.about: The Spin Me Round / Chipmunks Dance style keeps your dancers human. Solo, duo and trio use their own routines, with foreground turns and playful moments toward a steady camera.
spin-me-round.photoHint: Use a separate, clear portrait for every dancer. Visible clothing helps guide the look; the room is already included.
spin-me-round.sound: Includes model-generated original synth-pop. Add a different soundtrack in your own editor after downloading.
spin-me-round.faqQ: Can I choose the scene and group size?
spin-me-round.faqA: Yes. Choose Solo, Duo or Trio and either Empty room or Retro neon. Check the duration and other settings before requesting a quote.

58th-floor.title: 58th Floor AI
58th-floor.lead: Take your turn at a silver hanging mic in a teal studio. Create a 15-second rap with one performer, a duo or a person and pet.
58th-floor.about: The scene centers on a teal backdrop and a shared hanging microphone. The duo preset passes the performance between left and right; solo adapts both sections to one subject.
58th-floor.photoHint: Use one clear subject per photo. For a duo, the first photo is on the left and the second on the right. Person + pet uses a person first and a pet second.
58th-floor.sound: The lyrics and music direction are preset. The model generates the final voice, soundtrack and timing.
58th-floor.faqQ: How is this different from Green Booth?
58th-floor.faqA: 58th Floor uses an open teal stage and a hanging mic. Green Booth places two performers at one stand mic in a compact green-lit studio.

green-booth-freestyle.title: Green Booth Freestyle AI
green-booth-freestyle.lead: Share one mic in a green-lit studio. Your left performer opens with a raised-hand gesture while your right performer leads the rap.
green-booth-freestyle.about: Two separate portraits become a standing studio duo in a 10-second landscape video. The left performer supports the rhythm, the right leads, and both join the closing gestures around one black stand microphone.
green-booth-freestyle.photoHint: Add two separate portraits, one adult per photo. Left is the hype partner; right is the lead rapper. Swap the photos to change their roles.
green-booth-freestyle.sound: Preset audio guides the rhythm and lip movements. This template does not offer custom lyrics or voice cloning.
green-booth-freestyle.faqQ: Can I use a group photo or rap with a pet?
green-booth-freestyle.faqA: Use two separate portraits of consenting adults. This preset does not split a group photo or include a person-and-pet mode.

kung-fu-cat.title: Kung Fu Cat AI
kung-fu-cat.lead: Give your cat or dog a tiny martial-arts scene: quick paws, a tissue chop, fluttering paper and a very serious finish.
kung-fu-cat.about: This 9-second vertical pet comedy follows a short guard, a paw strike and a visible paper break in a living-room setting. Your photo guides the pet’s appearance; the choreography can vary.
kung-fu-cat.photoHint: Use one clear cat or dog photo. Keep the face, chest and front paws visible without another animal covering the body.
kung-fu-cat.sound: Original generated swishes, soft impacts and paper rustles accompany the movement.
kung-fu-cat.faqQ: Do I need to film my pet doing the moves?
kung-fu-cat.faqA: No. One photo is enough. The template supplies the tissue-chop routine and setting.

paws-at-you.title: Paws at You AI
paws-at-you.lead: A gentle paw toward the camera, a soft blink and drifting petals. Give your pet a six-second moment in a sunny meadow.
paws-at-you.about: One pet photo guides a close-up scene with eye contact, visible paw pads and a small head tilt. The paw reaches forward and draws back; a seamless loop is not guaranteed.
paws-at-you.photoHint: Choose one well-lit pet photo with clear eyes, face and front paws. Keep other animals out of the frame.
paws-at-you.sound: Original generated soft movement, a gentle tap and a light chime. No popular song is promised.
paws-at-you.faqQ: Will the example change my pet’s species?
paws-at-you.faqA: The example demonstrates the gesture and setting. Your own photo guides the pet’s species and markings, though AI details may vary.

source-hotel-lobby.title: Hotel Lobby AI
source-hotel-lobby.lead: Bring two portraits into one duo performance. Choose who appears on the left and right, then select your quality and framing.
source-hotel-lobby.about: Each photo supplies a performer, so the two people do not need to be photographed together. The orange-studio example illustrates the duet; it does not promise a hotel interior.
source-hotel-lobby.photoHint: Use two separate, clear portraits. Put the intended left performer first and the right performer second. Use Swap to reverse them.
source-hotel-lobby.sound: The original template determines the sound and performance. Check the finished video before sharing.
source-hotel-lobby.faqQ: Can I choose a specific duration?
source-hotel-lobby.faqA: This preset determines its own duration. You can choose the supported quality and framing without inventing a new performance length.

flying-car.title: Flying Car AI
flying-car.lead: Put a person, animal or object into a flying stunt. Choose a curved-ramp sequence or a jump over parked cars, all from one image.
flying-car.about: One Flying Car creator contains the original stunt options. The two curved-ramp versions run for 15 seconds and share a reference preview; the side and front fleet sequences run for 7 seconds. All use landscape 16:9.
flying-car.photoHint: Upload one clear image of your subject. A person, animal or object can be used; a portrait is not required. Keep the subject fully visible.
flying-car.sound: The selected original sequence supplies its audio direction. The final generated sound can differ from the preview.
flying-car.faqQ: Why are there different stunt options?
flying-car.faqA: They are the original sequences within the same effect, not separate tools. Changing the sequence changes its reference pack and performance; the two ramp versions share the same example clip.
